recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: a cybersecurity fortress darkened by the language beneath it
fire escapes rusting on brick facades, their purpose half-forgotten
startups planting roots in austin autumn soil
karl-the-fog rolling over san francisco at fourteen degrees
a long-awaited exchange closes one chapter at the border
autumn streets still parsing who lit the flame

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Switch between three swaying fire-escape ladders as fog rises—collect loose rivets before the landing rusts away beneath you.
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: a clean three-ladder sprint to the rooftop in under 40 seconds
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: fog climbs faster, rungs go missing, rivets spawn further off-center

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Tap in rhythm with pre-dawn shipping windows—each beat launches a commit that must land in the golden sunrise slot.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: nailing the final beat as the sun crests feels like a shipped build
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: tempo increases, syncopated beats, overlapping ship windows
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: coral sunrise gradients over terminal green

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Sort falling CLI commands into iOS shortcut slots before the agent queue overflows from your phone.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: clearing a full queue triggers a satisfying agent boot animation
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: more command types, faster drop rate, decoy flags
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: glass morphism phone UI floating in grey fog

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Flick syntax braces at tumbling PHP error logs to patch a server back online—each hit rewinds the downtime clock.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: one ricochet patch that clears five errors at once
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: log avalanche, smaller hitboxes, downtime rewinds slower
